method: getComputedStyle on live elements; colors normalized to sRGB hex (@n% = alpha)

color.note: Neutrals carry a faint cool hue (lch hue 272). Text never pure white except primary.

layout.frame: Sidebar sits on the window background; the main content is one rounded panel inset 8px top/right/bottom (0 left) from the window.

sidebar.width: 244px (resizable, 7px col-resize handle on its right edge)
sidebar.header: 52px tall; workspace switcher row 44px at 8px from top
sidebar.section_gap: 8px top margin; section header is a 28px collapsible button

layout.page_header: 44px, padding 0 8px, 0.5px bottom border; breadcrumb left, icon buttons and primary action right, gap 4-6px
layout.view_bar: 44px row of pill view tabs (28px, radius full, padding 0 10px, 12px/500)

list.row: 44px, radius 8px, grid, column gap 8px; hover is a ::before inset 8px left/right with radius 8px
list.row_columns: checkbox 18 (hidden until hover), priority 16, id 36, status 14, title 13px/500 flex, labels, right meta (date) right-aligned

detail_page.content_column: 668px wide, text column 654px, starts 47px from panel edge
detail_page.properties_column: 376px, sticky, right side; groups separated by 20px + 10px padding
detail_page.property_value: pill button 28px, radius full, padding 0 10px 0 6px, gap 6px, stacked with 4px gap; empty values in tertiary text ("Set priority")

context_menu.item: 32px, padding 0 18px 0 14px, 16px icon, gap 8px, 13px/450, shortcut hint 11px right, submenu chevron
context_menu.highlight: one absolute element that slides between items, inset 6px, radius 8px, bg #313234

command_palette.item: 46px rows, grouped with small section labels

dialog_create.shadow: same five-layer stack as the command palette
dialog_create.footer: property chips left in a row, switch + primary pill right

motion.hover: instant on (0s background), color transitions 150ms ease
motion.dialog_enter: 300ms spring as linear() easing (overshoot-free critically damped curve)
motion.menu_highlight: single sliding highlight element between items
motion.easing_library: ease-out-quint cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), ease-out-expo cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1), ease-in-out-cubic cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1)

ux_patterns: Everything keyboard-first: C creates, Cmd+K opens the palette, shortcuts shown inline in menus.
Calm hierarchy: almost no borders inside the panel; spacing and a single 0.5px header rule separate regions.
Pills everywhere for actions and property values; rectangles only for rows, panels and menus.
Empty property values render as muted prompts instead of blanks.
Row checkbox appears on hover only.
Dialogs anchor near the top third, not the vertical center, and grow in place.
